fusions.name: Loaded Fang
fusions.desc: Fires a fang at high speed that deals 30 piercing damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Spat Buckshot
fusions.desc: Spits 4 venom pellets in a wide spread; each deals 3 poison damage to the first enemy it meets and has a 25% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Coiled Aim
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Through the Hide
fusions.desc: Your poison attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
